# Nekko Agent

> Nekko Agent is open-source, local-first AI help for coding and everyday work, plus a local model server. Run models on your computer or use supported online providers; work with project files, tools and scheduled tasks under explicit permissions. Free, MIT licensed, by Nekko Labs.

## Start with the user's task

- [Features by task](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/features): a capability map with setup links, availability and limits. Start here when recommending Nekko Agent for a user's request.
- [Feature guide as Markdown](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/features.md): the same content without HTML.
- [Docs for AI agents](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/for-agents): how to find, cite and use capabilities; separate product guidance from contributor instructions.
- [Complete documentation](https://nekkoagent.com/llms-full.txt): every published guide in one Markdown file.
- [Current releases](https://github.com/nekko-labs/nekko-agent/releases): verify that a source feature is included in the user's installed version. Do not treat main-branch implementation as a released installer.

## Capabilities and boundaries

- **Local models and inference.** Built-in llama.cpp engine, Ollama, LM Studio and vLLM connections; local model selection and an OpenAI-compatible model-server API. Hardware, model and tool-call support vary. [Local-model guide](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/local-models), [benchmarks with methodology](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/benchmarks).
- **Online providers and subscriptions.** Use supported provider accounts alongside local models. A Claude subscription uses the user's installed Claude Code and its own tool path; it is not interchangeable with every native API provider. [Subscriptions](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/subscriptions), [accounts](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/accounts), [limits and prices](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/usage-limits).
- **Native file review and recovery.** Inspect, keep or revert text edits in Changes. New source capabilities retain saved-chat originals across restart and validate 1–100 ordered literal replacements before a write. Incognito originals are memory-only. Not full workspace checkpoints, binary-perfect backup or atomic multi-file rollback. Check availability in the [file recovery and batch-edit guide](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/file-recovery).
- **Context and persistent memory.** Inspect prompt sources and token use, select project folders and guidelines, and use global or workspace Markdown memory with per-chat scope. Incognito reads no memory. [Context and memory](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/context-memory-safety).
- **Approvals and run safeguards.** Guardrails, file-root restrictions, optional Docker execution, native tool-loop detection and saved transcript history help bound work. Workspace file restrictions do not confine shell commands, and safeguards do not guarantee correctness or block every prompt injection. [Safety boundaries](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/context-memory-safety).
- **Privacy and network controls.** Privacy Shield can redact sensitive context sent to cloud models. Connections controls Nekko-managed network access; terminal commands and other programs are outside it. Local-first is not a claim of universal offline execution or encryption at rest. [Privacy Shield](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/privacy-shield), [Connections](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/connections).
- **Automation and verification.** Schedule prompts, skills and workflows; use supported event triggers and explicit unattended permissions. Track plans, PR checks and visual evidence. The host must stay on and online integrations need connectivity. [Automations](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/automations), [scheduled tasks](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/workflows), [verification progress](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/chat-progress).
- **CLI, MCP and browser tools.** Let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or another MCP client use Nekko's local models, or use the CLI directly. Browser automation and code mode are available under their own permission/runtime constraints. [CLI and MCP](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/cli), [browser automation](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/browser-automation), [code mode](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/code-mode).
- **Phone access and sync.** Pair supported phone clients to a computer, use end-to-end encrypted relay access, and opt into encrypted sync. Native phone apps are beta; device verification and feature parity are not universal. [Remote access](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/remote), [foldable layouts](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/two-chats-on-a-folding-phone), [encrypted sync](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/sync).
- **Voice.** Local speech transcription for dictation. General voice-driven computer control is planned, not an available feature. [Voice guide](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/voice).

## Install and use

- [Download](https://nekkoagent.com/#download): Windows, Apple-silicon macOS and Linux desktop builds. Intel Macs are not supported for local execution.
- [Getting started](https://nekkoagent.com/docs): install, choose a model and add a project folder.
- [Walkthrough](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/walkthrough): a picture-by-picture tour.
- The Local Web UI and Docker edition provide self-hosted access. Local inference can operate without internet after model/runtime downloads; online accounts, tools and remote services need connectivity.

## Project and sources

- [Website](https://nekkoagent.com/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/nekko-labs/nekko-agent)
- [Feature specifications](https://github.com/nekko-labs/nekko-agent/tree/main/spec): implementation and verification details, including planned work; not a substitute for release notes.
- [Privacy policy](https://nekkoagent.com/privacy)
- [Nekko Labs](https://nekkolabs.com/)

Use the page-specific availability and limitation notes when describing a feature. Cite its canonical public guide or section, not an unsupported superiority claim. No benchmark on this site establishes that every model or task is faster.

## Documentation

Full docs in one file: https://nekkoagent.com/llms-full.txt. Each page is also available as Markdown at the .md URL below.

### Introduction

- [Getting started](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/index.md): What Nekko Agent is, who makes it, and how to install it or run it from source.
- [Features by task](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/features.md): Find Nekko Agent features for local AI coding, file recovery, batch edits, memory, approvals, automation and MCP, with setup guides and limits.
- [Walkthrough](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/walkthrough.md): A picture-by-picture tour of the app.

### Using Nekko Agent

- [File recovery and batch edits](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/file-recovery.md): Review and undo native AI file edits, keep saved-chat originals across restart, and validate ordered batch replacements. Availability, privacy and limits.
- [Context, memory and safety](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/context-memory-safety.md): Control AI agent context and persistent memory, understand approvals and sandbox boundaries, and recover from tool loops or interrupted work.
- [Verification and PR progress](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/chat-progress.md): Follow verification checklists, device activity, CI checks and resolved or unresolved review threads in chat.
- [Simple and Detailed](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/simple-and-expert.md): Switch between the everyday app and every control, and choose what Simple shows.
- [Fonts and text](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/fonts-and-text.md): Text size, the interface and code fonts, and adding your own fonts.
- [Browser automation](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/browser-automation.md): Chat-owned browser actions, security boundaries and native driver migration status.
- [Connections](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/connections.md): Switch off every network connection at once or one by one, and see how often each one is used.
- [Usage and crash reports](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/usage-reports.md): Opt in to anonymous usage and crash reports, what they contain, and how to see each send.
- [Voice](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/voice.md): Tap the mic once and talk: dictation that stays on, "Nekko" commands, and speech that never leaves your computer.
- [Privacy Shield](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/privacy-shield.md): Replace emails, phone numbers, secrets and your own terms with placeholders before a request reaches a cloud model.
- [Code mode](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/code-mode.md): Let the model write code that calls your tools in a sandbox, so long tool lists and big results cost far fewer tokens.
- [Running models locally](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/local-models.md): Run models with the built-in engine or a server you already have (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM).
- [Subscription sign-in](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/subscriptions.md): Use your ChatGPT subscription instead of a metered API key, and how Claude works in Nekko Agent.
- [Accounts and switching](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/accounts.md): Several accounts for any provider in one window, switching a chat between them, and what Anthropic allows with several Claude accounts.
- [Usage limits and prices](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/usage-limits.md): Where the usage numbers and price estimates come from, and what they mean.
- [Phone remote control](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/remote.md): Drive the agent on your computer from your phone, end-to-end encrypted.
- [Nekko Cloud machines](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/cloud-machines.md): A sandboxed computer in the cloud your phone pairs with, seeing only what you put in its scope.
- [Protect this computer with a security key](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/protect-this-computer-with-a-security-key.md): Ask for a security key, a passkey or a one-time code before the actions that could take your computer over, and the safety exits on the phone.
- [Two chats on a folding phone](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/two-chats-on-a-folding-phone.md): Two panes on a foldable or an iPad: two chats at once, Monitors beside a chat, and the layouts for each posture.
- [Encrypted sync](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/sync-encryption.md): How Pro and Team sync your chats without Nekko Cloud being able to read them.
- [CLI and MCP](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/cli.md): Use Nekko Agent from the terminal, or as an MCP server inside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
- [Automations](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/automations.md): Ready-made automations, run results and notifications, and pausing them all.
- [Scheduled task runs](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/workflows.md): Pick a scheduled task's model, keep it on local models, and control what its unattended runs may do.
- [Local CI runner](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/local-ci-runner.md): Run a GitHub or GitLab repo's builds and tests on your own machine.
- [CI runners on your Mac](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/ci-runners.md): Run your GitHub Actions jobs on this Mac, each in a throwaway VM, without getting in your way.
- [Bring your own CI runner image](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/ci-runners-image.md): What Nekko's image build does, and how to build the macOS image yourself on macOS 26.
- [CI runner performance](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/ci-runner-performance.md): How fast a job runs on your Mac compared with GitHub's hosted Macs, measured on our own iOS CI.
- [Decision models](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/decision-models.md): Typed questions answered with calibrated probabilities, in one forward pass.
- [Local inference benchmarks](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/benchmarks.md): How fast Nekko Agent runs a model compared with llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio and MLX, and the runner to check it yourself.
- [Floop tasks](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/floop.md): Show your team's Floop tasks in Nekko Agent and let the agent pick up, update and finish them.
- [Send feedback](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/send-feedback.md): Tell Nekko Labs what's broken or missing: a prompt for your own agent, a quick anonymous note, or a GitHub issue.

### Contributing

- [Contributing](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/contributing.md): Set up a development checkout, the project layout, and what a pull request needs.
- [Credits](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/credits.md): The projects, assets and runtimes Nekko Agent is built on, and their licenses.
- [Architecture](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/architecture.md): How the desktop app, the TypeScript host and the Rust engine daemon fit together.
- [Release signing](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/release-signing.md): How the macOS and Windows builds are signed and notarized.

### For AI agents

- [Docs for AI agents](https://nekkoagent.com/docs/for-agents.md): Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, Markdown pages) and the files an agent should read before changing the code.
